title: A custom role can change part status only once Delete is granted
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Staff member {User-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST PL-GRANT) works at {Location-A} with the custom role {Role-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GRANT-ROLE), which has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and See Financial Data but not 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete'.
  • {User-B} is signed in in a second browser window (for example a private window), and the Admin stays signed in in the first window.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-GRANT-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}, with 2 in {Bin-A}.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab in {User-B}'s window.
custom_steps:
1. In {User-B}'s window search {Part-A} and click its row.
  2. Look at Part Status, then click Cancel.
  3. In the Admin window go to Settings → Roles & Permissions, edit {Role-B}, tick Delete in the Part Library and Inventory group and click Save.
  4. In {User-B}'s window reload the page and click the ⋮ actions menu.
  5. Press Esc, search {Part-A} and click its row.
  6. Pick Inactive under Part Status.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  9. Click the Inactive tab, search {Part-A} and click its row.
  10. Pick Active under Part Status and click Save.
  11. Click Activate in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: Part Status shows Active and Inactive, but both options are disabled (greyed, cannot be picked).
  • Step 3: The role is saved.
  • Step 4: The menu now shows Cycle count, Deactivate parts and Export: the role has exactly what was granted.
  • Step 7: The confirmation "Deactivate part?" opens.
  • Step 8: The toast reads "Part deactivated." and {Part-A} leaves the Active tab: setting a part inactive works once Delete is granted.
  • Step 10: The confirmation "Activate part?" opens.
  • Step 11: The toast reads "Part activated." and {Part-A} leaves the Inactive tab.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10821 (Story 8, Permissions); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S8-R1, S8-R2, S8-R16, with the toasts from §8 (Part deactivated and Part activated from the part dialog), read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas boards 3.1 to 3.4 and 3.7 (Retire one part), 13 Oct copy, unchanged on 14 Oct. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R1: “Setting a part inactive requires the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission.”
  • S8-R2: “Setting a part active requires the same permission.”
  • S8-R16: “A custom role has only the permissions granted to it.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part deactivated from the part dialog): “"Part deactivated." | Success toast, fades on its own”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Part activated from the part dialog): “"Part activated." | Success toast, fades on its own”
